## Invitations

A total of 2038 people were invited during the reporting period. Of these, 1496 attended. This represents an attendance rate of 73.4 per cent. The figures provide a straightforward comparison between the number of invitations issued and the number of people who attended.

Operational arrangements continued to reflect local access conditions. Van days were maintained where roads allowed, supporting delivery of outreach activity in locations that could be reached safely. Where road conditions did not allow access, the available outreach arrangements were applied as appropriate.

## Contact

SMS contact was used for 1717 invitees. Reminders were also sent to 1717 invitees. These figures are reported separately to show the scale of direct contact and reminder activity associated with the invitations.

The information above summarises invitations, attendance, contact activity and the practical arrangements recorded for the period. It is intended to support routine monitoring of outreach delivery and attendance.

Prepared by G. Evans.
